items.name: Harris Rapier
items.appearance: A thin, iron-black rapier.
items.function: Absolute Destruction

items.name: Dream of Eternity
items.appearance: A dark heart.
items.function: Can pull multiple people into the same dream.
items.downside: Using it at its maximum range leaves the user with strong mental trauma.

items.name: Pride Armor
items.appearance: A silver-white full-body armor.
items.function: Grants the user abilities of a Dawn Paladin
items.downside:
1. Wearer hold disdain for those standing behind them and targets concealed in the darkness or invisible. They may attack them.
2. It indiscriminately eliminates weak humans within a 50-meter radius. Should the wearer weaken, they too become a target.
3. The wearer of the armor eventually experiences varying degrees of betrayal, irrespective of whether they still wear the item.
4. The wearer is vulnerable to its attacks when using other mystical items.

items.name: Tanago Scarecrow
items.appearance: A scarecrow, parts of it were made of brownish-green straw, but its arms, chest, and thighs were covered in real skin.
items.function: Erases people within 30-meter radius.
items.downside: Affects the user as well.

items.appearance: A golden box engraved with symbols and magic labels.
items.function: Maintains the internal temperature inside the box.
items.downside:
1. Long contact turns the person into Eternal Blazing Sun believer.
2. Objects placed inside will develop sentience.

items.name: Blood Vessel Thief
items.appearance: A thick, stiffened blood vessel.
items.function: Can steal abilities and let the user use them for 10 minutes, the stolen would need a few days to recover it.
items.downside: Drains the user's lifespan.

items.appearance: A ring inlaid with many tiny diamonds.
items.function: Imitates Beyonder abilities the user has seen, identifies abilities and items.
items.downside: Overworks the user's brain, leading to retardation if used for too long.

items.name: Door of Death
items.appearance: Normally a normal wooden door. It can disguise itself into pre-existing doors.
items.function: Kills whoever walks through.
items.downside: Tries to escape and disguise itself as a normal door.

items.name: Antigonus Family Puppet
items.appearance: A puppet covered in an oil-stained brown cloth, its face is painted like a clown in red and yellow.
items.function: Slows people nearby down, physically and mentally.
items.downside: Affects everybody, including the user.

items.name: Inexhaustible Poison
items.appearance: A silver cup filled with a crystal-clear liquid.
items.function: Tempts and kills the drinker.
items.downside: Affects everyone around it including the user.

items.name: Wintry Blade
items.appearance: A transparent, nearly invisible triangular blade.
items.function: Freezes the body and thoughts of those pierced by it. Turns thoughts and movements of enemies sluggish and rigid.
items.downside: Slowly losing body temperature. Once the limit is exceeded (3 or 4 hours), the holder turn into an undead.

items.name: Word of the Sea
items.appearance: A black silver-inlaid cane.
items.function: The holder can use lightning, wind, water, acid rain, underwater breathing, and flight.
items.downside: Sings dangerous songs, living artifact that attacks the user, and attracts lightning.

items.name: Gargoyle Glasses
items.appearance: Grayish-white glasses.
items.function: Making people turn numb.
items.downside: The user loses agility, user can become numb if used in front of the mirror.

items.name: Hand of Horror
items.appearance: A long black glove made of gauze.
items.function:
1. Charm Bribe: By giving the target an item, the target will have positive emotions toward the user.
2. Distortion: By twisting the words, actions, and intentions of their target, they can produce "order."
3. Confusion: They can make the target or a specific location "confused."
4. Majesty: They can display a sense of great majesty, causing others to want to lower their bodies and obey them.
items.downside:
The user becomes dishonest and corrupt.
The user becomes confused when he worn it for too long.

items.name: Flower of Blood
items.appearance: A gold ring with an inlaid ruby.
items.function: It gives the user flesh and blood magic, including regeneration.
items.downside: The user randomly loses thinking and reasoning ability.
items.status: Lost during the George III's Apotheosis Ritual

items.name: Thunder God's Roar
items.appearance: A heavy, dark blue hammer, surrounded by silvery electric light. Its handle resembles the leg bone of a creature.
items.function: It can produce sounds that left the enemy in fear and chaos, and destructive lightning when used.
items.downside: Increases the probability of being attacked in the dark to 100%, the holder becomes irritated more easily.

items.name: Scales of Luck
items.appearance: A silver necklace, it has an ancient coin as a pendant with words carved in ancient Hermes: "You will be as unlucky as you are lucky now."
items.function:
1. Make the wearer lucky: in daily life, the user will encounter good things from time to time.
2. In the event of great peril, the wearer becomes absurdly lucky for ten minutes.
3. The wearer can actively give the enemy bad luck.
items.downside: After having been lucky, the user become likewise unlucky. The luck gained in the battle will be reversed in the same fierce way after ten minutes.

items.name: Death Knell
items.appearance: An iron black revolver.
items.function:
1. Finds and aim precisely the target's weakness.
2. Increase damages.
3. Shotgun effect.
items.downside:
Gives the user a random phobia for 6 hours.
The user will also be continuously thirsty.

items.name: Leymano's Travels
items.appearance: A palm-sized notebook with a hard copper-green outer casing.
items.function: Copies Beyonder abilities it has seen, allowing them to be reused only once.
items.downside: Makes the user lost. This can be avoided by smearing his blood on its cover.

items.name: Tinder
items.appearance: A glove that can change its color.
items.function:
1. Enhance the user's charm, making his words very convincing.
2. Can steal a target's ability and allow the wearer to use it for 10 minutes. The stolen would need at least 12 hours to recover it.
items.downside:
1. Before he can steal someone's ability, the wearer need to let the glove take one of his own power for 12 hours, in exchange he would be allowed to use steal as many time he wants for 12 hours.
2. The wearer is more likely to lose his carried items.

items.name: Whip of Mind
items.appearance: A black iron ring with a spiked bulge stained with blood at the top.
items.function:
Cause mental damage to the target.
The wearer becomes more proficient with various weapons.
items.downside: Gives the user headaches.

items.name: Lie
items.appearance: Normally a silver half-mask, but it can change its appearance.
items.function: Appearance Morphing, Flame Controlling, Damage Transfer, Improved balance and agility, Danger intuition.
items.downside: The user's emotions will be amplified.

items.name: Gold Mask
items.appearance: A golden mask with rough facial features.
items.function: Enhanced physical abilities, curse, and black magic.
items.downside: Lose your humanity the more you use it.

items.name: Scarlet Lunar Corona
items.appearance: A dark red moon-shaped accessory.
items.function: Make the user immune to the influence of the full moon. Simulates the full moon, gives user great speed, rejuvenation, and darkness spells.
items.downside: The user's blood slowly freezes as long as he keeps it active. If he doesn't stop, or drink the blood of a living person, he will ultimately die.

items.name: Shapeshifting Hat
items.appearance: A hat that can change its shapes.
items.function: Wearing it allows to move freely underwater for 30 minutes and use some Water and Wind domain spells.
items.downside: You will desire water; on land you will gradually weaken.

items.name: Sun Brooch
items.appearance: Brooch
items.function: Gives access to Sun Pathway spells
items.downside: Makes the user feel very hot

items.name: Creeping Hunger
items.appearance: A thin human-skinned glove.
items.function:
1. Can use the stored souls' Beyonder abilities.
2. Allows the user to hide in shadows.
3. Turn bodies into flesh bombs.
items.downside:
Consumes a human's soul and flesh for each twenty-four-hour period it is used.
It will praise the True Creator from time to time.

items.name: Biological Poison Bottle
items.appearance: A translucent bottle.
items.function: Produces a variety of random poisonous fumes.
items.downside: Affects the user as well.

items.name: Traveler Robe
items.appearance: A classical black robe with a door-shaped symbol formed with three rubies, three emeralds, and three diamonds.
items.function: Allows the user to teleport.
items.downside: It gradually tightened the user's body after each uses.

items.name: Boxing Glove
items.appearance: An iron-black boxing glove.
items.function: Similar to Sequence 5 Guardian.
items.downside: The user becomes more rash and often acts without thinking.

items.name: All-Black Eye
items.appearance: A black, pupil-less eye.
items.function: User can see Spirit Body Threads, which can be used to find the hidden target.
items.downside: User will hears a illusory raving. Can mutate nearby creatures that have been contaminated by the True Creator.

items.name: Mental Terror Candle
items.appearance: A short candle with a black wick. It is wrapped in a layer of something that looks like human skin.
items.function: Entering the deepest part of the target's soul. There, the user would be able to resolve psychological issues, or plant a cue.
items.downside: After using it for five minutes, the user will completely lose consciousness, and his mind will never be able to return to his body.

items.name: Judge Button
items.appearance: An ordinary button.
items.function: Corresponding Sequence 6 Judge of the Justiciar Pathway.
items.downside: Wearer easily offends people or monsters.

items.name: Notary Certificate
items.appearance: An orange paper with symbols corresponding to the sun on it.
items.function: Can enforce contracts after somebody presses his palm against the blank area and makes an oath.
items.downside: The person who made the oath have to respect it or pay the price.

items.name: Sleep Bugle
items.appearance: A human skull bugle.
items.function: When blown, it produces a melody with the power to cause calmness.
items.downside: Unknown

items.name: Clown Mask
items.appearance: A thin and soft leather clown mask

items.name: Lifeblood
items.appearance: An injector made of rubber hoses, a glass syringe, and a thin needle
items.function: Once injected into the user body, it allows them to control their flesh and blood completely for a short period.
items.downside: With each injection, the user will become closer to the True Creator.

items.name: Decency
items.appearance: A golden brooch carved into a Scotch Broom

items.name: Cardi's Ring
items.appearance: An iron-black ring engraved with dark and complicated patterns.
items.function: Psychologically shock the target or cause the target to lose his reasoning.
items.downside: The user develops a split personality.

items.name: Integrity Brooch
items.appearance: A gold brooch.
items.function: Can create Holy sunlight and ignite materials to deal with ghost-type creatures.
items.downside:
Wearing it for too long will cause the wielder to become fanatical.
As long someone wear it, he will lose some thoughts.

items.name: Needle and Tube
items.appearance: A combination of a needle, a tube, and a container with mysterious patterns.
items.function: Can draw blood of the user, then transfuse it back later for healing and increased physical attributes.
items.downside:
1. Drawing blood weakens the user for 12 hours.
2. Using it too often will weaken the user permanently.
3. If someone carry it around for more than half an hour, he'll become a little neurotic.

items.name: Flog
items.appearance: A boxing glove
items.function:
*It induces a surge of desire or emotion of the target. The user can predict and influence the target's reaction, with a success rate of 70-80%.
*It possesses unparalleled sturdiness, capable of withstanding an assault from a Reaper without sustaining damage.
items.downside:
*Carrying the boxing glove will have a negative impact on one's self-control.
*Wearing the boxing glove will draw the attention of a hidden entity.

items.name: Shadow Bracelet
items.appearance: A Bracelet
items.function:
1. The user can conceal himself within larger shadows.
2. It can summon a Shadow Servant with a few special abilities and can bring shadows to life to restrain targets to some extent.

items.name: Arrow of the Bloodthirsty
items.appearance: A broken obsidian arrow

items.name: Ring of Punishment
items.appearance: An iron-colored ring with a thick band and slender spikes on its surface.
items.function: It can pierce a target's Spirit Body within a five-meter range, causing excruciating pain and rendering them temporarily unconscious.
items.downside:
1. Wearing it for an extended period will make the user, bloodthirsty, cruel, and impulsive.
2. If used more than three times in an hour, it will cause the wearer's personality to undergo mutation.
3. If removed, the user will suffer indiscriminate Psychic Piercing damage once he enters in a five-meter radius.

items.name: Symphony of Hatred
items.appearance: A charred bone flute.

items.name: Blade of Poison
items.appearance: A short blade.
items.function: Randomly poisons target on hit.
items.downside: Medicine becomes ineffective on user, feeling of drunkenness.

items.name: Fury of the Sea
items.appearance: Grayish-white lightning-shaped brooch
items.function: Underwater mobility and electric shock attack
items.downside: Heightened likelihood of being struck by lightning on rainy days, coupled with increased irritability and anxiety after wearing it.

items.name: Blood Gold
items.appearance: A golden ring that bears an engraving on its inner loop.
items.function: It gives the user the ability to control their flesh and blood and some flesh and blood magic.
items.downside: Repeated use may lead to dependence. Ceasing to wear it results in the body collapsing into a pile of flesh and blood, unable to maintain human form. Continual wear may lead to madness and loss of control.

items.name: Devil's Whisper
items.appearance: A pitch-black bone ring
items.function:
*Devil's Arm
*Malice Perception
*Desire Incarnation
*Wraith Shriek
items.downside:
*After wearing it, the user's malice will become more pronounced.
*Whether worn or not, just carrying it will cause the user's body to suffer burns from sulphur flames, both internally and externally.
*People within a hundred meters radius, including the user, will be subtly influenced by the Devil's Whisper, more prone to ill thoughts and impulsive actions.

items.name: Elf Flying Carpet
items.appearance: A peacock-blue carpet
items.function: Ability to suspend and fly

items.name: Mother of Success
items.appearance: A four-leaved clover charm
items.function: It allows the user to accumulate luck after each failure
items.downside: It would magnify the user shortcomings

items.name: Shermane Box
items.appearance: Box
items.function: Bestows beauty and charm onto people.
items.downside: Attracts people in a way where they lose their reasoning
